title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Lead SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, DAX, PostgreSQL, Python, and SharePoint reporting. Build KPI dashboards, automate recurring reports, improve data quality through validation and reconciliation, perform trend analysis, and partner with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership on business intelligence and operations insights.

title: Reporting Analyst
description: Create recurring reports and Excel dashboards, query data with SQL, validate source data, reconcile reporting differences, analyze trends, and communicate findings to stakeholders across operations and leadership teams.

title: Data Entry Clerk
description: Perform repetitive data entry clerk duties, copy information into spreadsheets, and complete basic administrative tasks with limited analytical responsibility or business intelligence work.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Develop Power BI dashboards, write SQL queries, define KPI reporting, improve data quality, and work with cross-functional stakeholders from the company's Chicago office five days per week.

title: Operations Analyst
description: Use SQL and Excel to analyze operations, build dashboards, monitor KPI trends, validate data, prepare leadership reporting, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders on process improvements. Compensation will be discussed during the interview process.
